result.retention: Large generated inputs/outputs removed only after full validation and SHA-256; compact reports retained

findings.finding: Native numeric sentinels are compared as bits before IEEE classification; read-only sentinels permit duplicates.
findings.disposition: Fixed bit-pattern maps, atomic duplicate-write rejection, signed-zero/NaN-payload precedence and explicit lossy read collision selection. Default unmatched IEEE values stay ordinary; Native normalization is opt-in.

findings.finding: Numeric projection alone cannot preserve NA/UNDEF/EPS/acronym identity or distinguish colliding ordinary sentinels.
findings.disposition: ProjectedValue always retains original Value, mapped acronym provenance and projected bits. Exact conversion rejects typed identity loss; AllowLoss is explicit. Typed scans/writes never consult maps.

findings.finding: Acronym-to-NA uses native internal NA rather than read-only NA; special reset preserves next IDs/mappings.
findings.disposition: Separate fixed internal/read state, explicit ToNotAvailable, exact default/read/loss/reset stream expectations in both implementations. Per-session state never mutates the core decoder or another session.

findings.finding: Native lazy automatic acronym allocation can collide with explicit mappings and AcronymValue can overflow f64 before i32 range exhaustion.
findings.disposition: Disk journal enforces active original/target bijections, stable assignments and checked finite encoding. Rust rejects ambiguous automatic IDs and overflow; isolated native probes document differences instead of counting them as parity.

findings.finding: Float conversion errors in unsorted/mapped adapters could invoke parent cleanup before cancelling an external sorter.
findings.disposition: Conversion returns to the owning adapter; it explicitly cancels the sorter and preserves cleanup errors before parent cleanup. Focused regression combines an arity conversion failure with denied cursor/run cleanup, verifies original kind plus secondary error and blocked publication.

findings.finding: Acronym metadata replacement can fail during allocation, copy, sync, rename or reopen, and both live journals consume resources.
findings.disposition: Owned auxiliary path established immediately after exclusive creation; both extents and buffers charged. Both handles close before rename. Pre/post replacement IO and quota regressions prove terminal failure, retryable cleanup and no publication.

findings.finding: Native acronym ordinal bounds use an incorrect OR condition and can permit invalid indexing.
findings.disposition: No invalid native ordinal indexing is invoked. Typed Rust IDs, Option information lookup, collision/encoding validation and malformed-value tests reject invalid policies safely.

findings.finding: Large acronym metadata or mapping histories must not become a hidden RAM table.
findings.disposition: Source metadata stays streamed with fixed-size information results; only explicit/encountered mapping frames live in quota-controlled scratch. Growing 2048 assignments across epochs crosses journal pages under the same root; reset keeps old bytes charged until close. Lazy initialization fault preserves directory ownership and secondary errors for abort retry.

limitations: Native reference helper runs on Linux within existing isolation bounds; four native Rust platforms qualify functionality/logical accounting, not OS RSS/performance parity.

Mapping lookups are linear; many active assignments can be quadratic. Information lookup scans source metadata; each writer acronym rename rewrites the journal. No throughput claim; task 031 retains general-input OS/RSS/performance acceptance.

Each explicit ValueSession is a separate scratch job with its own MetadataOptions and shared Reader memory root. Existing minimum six configured handles and journal half apply; the policy uses one live journal handle. Reset epochs do not reclaim journal bytes until close.

Mappings are immutable bijections within an epoch; identity encounters reserve targets. Native ambiguous automatic collisions and overflow-to-infinity encoding are rejected. Next IDs do not silently skip occupied targets.

No implicit unnamed writer registration, no late acronym metadata mutation after Writer freeze, no synthetic source catalog entries for discovered unknown IDs, no C ABI/error-number/call-state parity.
Projection applies to explicitly supplied typed values, in caller invocation order; unprojected fields allocate no mappings. Prior projections are not retroactively remapped or replayed.

Caller-retained projected values/information results consume caller memory. IEEE normalization and single-float identity loss are explicit. Fixed std/path/control-allocation limitations remain as recorded for the existing root allocator.

M3 smoke is regression coverage, not a repeated oversized scale qualification. No new dependencies, unsafe code, wire format, frozen generator or golden/fixture/hash relaxations. Tasks 029–031 remain pending.
